four_questions.what: get her wet pup Sam back inside
four_questions.how: she stays calm and calls him with a red ball

reference_sheet.character: Mia, age 5, light-brown skin, curly black hair, red shirt, happy
reference_sheet.art_style: soft watercolor, rounded shapes, bright and friendly

pages.text: I am Mia. Sam is my pup.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mia (see reference sheet) in a green backyard with her small tan pup Sam (see reference sheet), soft watercolor.

pages.text: Sam is wet. Sam is sad.
pages.illustration_prompt: Pup Sam wet by the wooden fence, looking sad, soft watercolor.

pages.text: Sam ran off. I can not get him.
pages.illustration_prompt: Sam running off, Mia reaching out, soft watercolor.

pages.text: I sit. I am not mad. I get a red ball.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mia sitting calmly holding a red ball, soft watercolor.

pages.text: Sam ran to me. I am so glad!
pages.illustration_prompt: Pup Sam running happily to Mia for the red ball, soft watercolor.

pages.text: Sam and I run in. Sam is not sad.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mia and dry, happy Sam going inside together, soft watercolor.
